snippet.title: Marathon | Creator Alpha Gameplay Highlights
snippet.description:
Two weeks ago, we invited creators to Bungie HQ. Today, we're sharing some of our favorite moments from the Alpha summit.

Thank you to everyone who joined us! We had a blast.

Up next is the first community playtest. Join the official Discord to sign-up for your chance to play and help shape the future of Marathon.

The Closed Alpha Test starts April 23, 2025.

🐛Sign up to playtest on Discord
discord.gg/marathonthegame

📺Gameplay Reveal Trailer
https://youtu.be/uZRGDZCl9pg

📺Gameplay Overview Trailer
https://youtu.be/ZvJIQoWIQP8

📺Reveal Cinematic Short
https://youtu.be/fvbEnWLRo1s
